title.text: Grocery Watch — D5 website mockup (civic atlas theme)

sample.text:
Store names, risk scores and resident counts on these screens are SAMPLE DATA for layout only.

Real figures used: store-type exit rates (2008–2018 training years), the train/validation/test years, the 90-day ownership-change rule, the data sources, and the Nov 4, 2026 USDA stocking rule.

[Brackets] = fill in from D3/D6 results.

tokens.text:
THEME TOKENS (for globals.css)

Paper (background) #F4EFE3
Paper light (inputs, receipt) #FFFDF7
Paper rule #D8CFBA
Ink (text, borders) #1C2B22
Ink secondary #4A5A50
Forest (primary) #1F5A3D
High risk (tomato) #B23A12
Medium risk (mustard) #D9A441, text #8A5A06
Low risk = hollow ink ring
Notice band #F3E3B8

Map shading (fewer → more exits): #F3E0A8 #E7B672 #D98654 #BC4B24 #86280D; no SNAP grocery #E1DBCF

Fonts: Bagel Fat One (wordmark only), Instrument Serif (headings; italic for emphasis), Inter Tight (body), IBM Plex Mono (labels). Receipt and shelf tags: Plex Mono + Fraunces numbers
Radius 4px. Rules, not cards.
